dealProvenance.canonicalDdl:
CREATE TABLE `terminal_history_deal_provenance_v4` (
  `id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `terminal_history_deal_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `trading_account_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `platform` enum('mt4','mt5') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `terminal_instance_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `terminal_profile_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `broker_server` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `account_login` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `connection_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `connection_epoch` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `ownership_revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `request_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `query_message_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `response_message_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `source_revision` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `source_kind` enum('terminal','local_projection') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `fact_sha256` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `provenance_sha256` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `observed_at_utc` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `received_at_utc` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `created_at_utc` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_history_deal_provenance_response` (`terminal_history_deal_id`,`response_message_id`),
  KEY `idx_history_deal_provenance_identity` (`trading_account_id`,`terminal_instance_id`,`terminal_history_deal_id`),
  KEY `fk_history_deal_provenance_user` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_history_deal_provenance_account` FOREIGN KEY (`trading_account_id`) REFERENCES `trading_accounts` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_history_deal_provenance_deal` FOREIGN KEY (`terminal_history_deal_id`) REFERENCES `terminal_history_deals_v4` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_history_deal_provenance_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_history_deal_provenance_hashes` CHECK ((regexp_like(`fact_sha256`,_utf8mb4'^[0-9a-f]{64}$',_utf8mb4'c') and regexp_like(`provenance_sha256`,_utf8mb4'^[0-9a-f]{64}$',_utf8mb4'c'))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_history_deal_provenance_revisions` CHECK (((`connection_epoch` > 0) and (`ownership_revision` > 0)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

collectionTasks.canonicalDdl:
CREATE TABLE `history_collection_tasks_v4` (
  `id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `trading_account_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('pending','running','completing','succeeded','failed') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `range_start_utc` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `range_end_utc` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `attempts` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `lease_token` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `lease_expires_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `route_json` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `route_sha256` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `completion_json` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `completion_sha256` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `result_receipt_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `error_code` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at_utc` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at_utc` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `completed_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `active_account_id` bigint unsigned GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when (`status` in (_utf8mb4'pending',_utf8mb4'running',_utf8mb4'completing')) then `trading_account_id` else NULL end)) STORED,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_history_task_active_account` (`active_account_id`),
  KEY `idx_history_task_recovery` (`status`,`lease_expires_at_utc`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_history_task_account` (`trading_account_id`,`created_at_utc`,`id`),
  KEY `fk_history_task_receipt` (`result_receipt_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_history_task_account` FOREIGN KEY (`trading_account_id`) REFERENCES `trading_accounts` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_history_task_receipt` FOREIGN KEY (`result_receipt_id`) REFERENCES `terminal_history_collection_receipts_v4` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_history_task_completion` CHECK ((((`completion_json` is null) and (`completion_sha256` is null) and (`status` in (_utf8mb4'pending',_utf8mb4'running',_utf8mb4'failed'))) or ((`completion_json` is not null) and (`completion_sha256` is not null) and regexp_like(`completion_sha256`,_utf8mb4'^[0-9a-f]{64}$',_utf8mb4'c') and (`status` in (_utf8mb4'completing',_utf8mb4'succeeded',_utf8mb4'failed'))))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_history_task_lease` CHECK ((((`status` in (_utf8mb4'running',_utf8mb4'completing')) and (`lease_token` is not null) and (`lease_expires_at_utc` is not null)) or ((`status` not in (_utf8mb4'running',_utf8mb4'completing')) and (`lease_token` is null) and (`lease_expires_at_utc` is null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_history_task_result` CHECK ((((`status` in (_utf8mb4'pending',_utf8mb4'running',_utf8mb4'completing')) and (`completed_at_utc` is null) and (`result_receipt_id` is null)) or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'succeeded') and (`completed_at_utc` is not null) and (`result_receipt_id` is not null)) or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'failed') and (`completed_at_utc` is not null) and (`result_receipt_id` is null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_history_task_route` CHECK ((((`route_json` is null) and (`route_sha256` is null) and (`status` in (_utf8mb4'pending',_utf8mb4'failed'))) or ((`route_json` is not null) and (`route_sha256` is not null) and regexp_like(`route_sha256`,_utf8mb4'^[0-9a-f]{64}$',_utf8mb4'c')))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_history_task_window` CHECK ((`range_end_utc` > `range_start_utc`))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
